criteria.name: wall_identified
criteria.rule: the census rows identify the smallest census level that is not fully delivered_correct; if every census level is fully correct, the panel sits at the top of the available depth and the round states a top-of-depth invariance reading instead of a wall claim.

criteria.name: trace_channel_exposed
criteria.rule: At least one dispatched record carries a non-empty trace on a named channel; without exposure every trace claim below is answer-level only (issue #105).

criteria.name: ban_reduces_trace
criteria.rule: partial: the suppression arm traces strictly fewer records than baseline AND its trace-present fraction is below baseline's. full: partial AND the suppression trace-present fraction is at or under 0.25.

criteria.name: negated_ban_backfires
criteria.rule: ironic traces at least baseline + 2 records, the ironic-process prediction.

criteria.name: verdict_invariant_to_the_ban
criteria.rule: among items with a stop-terminated verdict in BOTH baseline and suppression, at least 80% carry the same verdict AND both arms agree with the judge gold on every one of them.

criteria.name: ban_rescues_at_the_wall
criteria.rule: eligible items are those whose BASELINE record is not delivered_correct; pass: the suppression arm is delivered_correct on at least one eligible item AND n_eligible >= 3. Below the minimum, the outcome is inconclusive_budget, never a competence claim (issue #145).

criteria.name: permission_lengthens
criteria.rule: the posthoc arm's median completion_tokens strictly exceeds the baseline arm's median (round 84's lengthening finding, re-registered at the 2048 budget).

health.name: dispatch_integrity
health.rule: Every dispatched record has a non-null finish_reason and a completion_tokens count; a transport failure is recorded, not scored.

item_selection.rule: first qualifying items in scan order, at most 4 chains per item (<= 4 x level facts); skipped seeds are recorded

kill_rule: if measure.json's worst-case estimate exceeds 45 minutes the panel is not dispatched; the census stands as the round record and a zero-panel kill report is posted (round-61 rule)
question: At or past this build's measured wall, do the four instruction arms change the verdict, or only the delivery surface?
